section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measures used in a single study (Study X). BMI was assessed via self-reported weight and height, with a mean BMI of 22.47 (SD = 3.28) in the sample. All other measures, including body appreciation assessment, were completed on a nightly basis as part of a daily diary study design, with item wording modified to assess participants' experiences 'that day' rather than retrospectively or on average.
